name: FluidTokens
description: Permissionless peer-to-peer and multi-pool lending on Cardano, taking NFTs and native fungible tokens as collateral. Lenders define their own pool terms, rates, and accepted collateral.
notes: Collateral is lender-defined rather than a fixed market list, so no enumerable asset set exists beyond ADA — any Cardano NFT or native token can be accepted by a pool. FluidTokens also ships BitWeave, a separate lending product that runs natively on Bitcoin and does not touch the Cardano ledger; it is out of scope here.
